title.en: Chapter 1 — Passepartout Finds a New Master

book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: بلندن، سنة 1872، كان في رجل اسمه فيلياس فوغ.
sentences.en: In London, in 1872, there was a man named Phileas Fogg.

sentences.ar: ما حدا بيعرف من وين إجا، ولا من وين مصاريه.
sentences.en: No one knew where he came from, or where his money came from.

sentences.ar: بس الكل بيعرف إنه غني، وهادي، ودقيق.
sentences.en: But everyone knew he was rich, quiet, and precise.

sentences.ar: كان يطلع من بيته الساعة 11:30 بالضبط.
sentences.en: He left his house at 11:30 exactly.

sentences.ar: ويمشي لنادي ريفورم بنفس الخطوات كل يوم.
sentences.en: And walked to the Reform Club with the same steps every day.

sentences.ar: وياكل على نفس الطاولة، ويقرا نفس الجرايد.
sentences.en: And ate at the same table, and read the same papers.

sentences.ar: ويلعب ورق، ويرجع الساعة اتناعشر بالليل.
sentences.en: And played cards, and came home at midnight.
And so every day, for years.

sentences.ar: وبهاليوم، الثاني من أكتوبر، طرد خادمه.
sentences.en: And on this day, the second of October, he dismissed his servant.

sentences.ar: لأنه جاب له مي الحلاقة بحرارة 84 درجة، مش 86.
sentences.en: Because he brought his shaving water at 84 degrees, not 86.
And he was waiting for the new servant.
At 11:29, there was a knock.

sentences.ar: ودخل شاب فرنسي، وجهه مبتسم، وشعره أشقر مبعتر.
sentences.en: And a young Frenchman came in, with a smiling face and tousled fair hair.
He said: my name is Jean Passepartout.

sentences.ar: اشتغلت كل شي: مغني، وبهلوان، ورجل إطفاء.
sentences.en: I have done everything: singer, acrobat, fireman.
And now I want a quiet life.
Fogg said: Passepartout.
A good name.
I have heard good things of you.
Do you know my conditions?
Passepartout said: I do, sir.
Fogg said: what time is it?
Passepartout took out his watch, and said: 11:22.

sentences.ar: قال فوغ: ساعتك متأخرة أربع دقايق.
sentences.en: Fogg said: your watch is four minutes slow.
No matter.
From this moment, 11:29, you are in my service.
And Fogg rose, took his hat, and went out.
Without another word.
And Passepartout was left standing in the house alone.
And said: a quiet house.
A quiet master.
This is what I want.

sentences.ar: وما كان بيعرف إنه بعد عشر ساعات، بيكون بقطار لباريس.
sentences.en: And he did not know that in ten hours, he would be on a train to Paris.
